item.title: Democrats Will Wield Enormous Power in Statehouses. What Will They Do?

item.title: Nvidia Fallout Looms Over Trump-Xi Meeting
item.description: So far, President Trump has indicated that he does not plan to press the Chinese leader about U.S. intelligence findings that a Chinese spy targeted Jensen Huang.

item.media:description: When President Trump travels to China for another meeting with Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, Jensen Huang is not expected to be at his side.

item.title: Chris Van Hollen Says His Majority Leader Challenge to Chuck Schumer Is Gaining Support

item.dc:creator: Annie Karni
